thread:
maria: heads up — after the firewall tighten in eu-west we started seeing auditshipper timeouts and a cascade that delayed GPU node warmups by ~8-12m this morning.
kevin: ugh. which firewall change? the recent default-deny or the new SNI inspection policy?
alex: SNI inspection + stricter egress sampling. auditshipper couldn't reach the central S3 endpoint so keystore decrypts stalled on join.
maria: logs: `ERROR auditshipper: put s3 object failed: dial tcp 10.10.0.45:443: i/o timeout` — NATGW conntrack was sitting at ~65k entries.
julia: that explains the slow provisioning. GPUs sit idle while keystore waiters spin and kubelet fails join checks.
kevin: we tightened to block unknown outbound flows for compliance. didn't expect conntrack blowup. :grimacing:
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: canary deploy of fw-rule-2026-03-21 returned 504s for auditshipper services in eu-west-1.
maria: short-term mitigation: open ephemeral egress to keystore S3 for auditshipper hosts and allow privatelink for keystore proxy.
alex: also we should throttle audit sampling on warmup windows. reducing sample rate from 1.0 -> 0.1 drops steady egress by ~9x.
julia: cost note: opening NATGW sessions will spike NATGW and egress fees if we keep it wide for hours. prefer privatelink route.
kevin: security OK with a narrow allowlist to s3 keystore buckets + privatelink for 30m if we have an ops rollback plan documented.
maria: plan: 1) add SG egress allowlist for auditshipper -> 10.20.5.0/24:443 (30m), 2) create privatelink endpoint for keystore proxy in eu-west, 3) lower audit sample to 10% during warmup windows, 4) drain and reprovision affected GPU nodes.
alex: commands I ran to validate conntrack:
```
sudo conntrack -L | wc -l
sudo netstat -tnp | grep 10.20.5
kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o wide
```
maria: rollout snippet for the SG change (tf):
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "auditshipper_allow" {
  type        = "egress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.20.5.0/24"]
  description = "temporary allowlist for auditshipper -> keystore s3"
}
```
kevin: add expiration comment + runbook link in the TF change. make sure to tag with compliance:temporal=true.
julia: who owns privatelink setup? I can spin it but need the keystore team to accept endpoint policy.
maria: @kevin can you coordinate the endpoint policy approval? alex — please run sample-rate change and node drain when SG is applied.
kevin: on it. will post the policy and approval checkbox.
alex: target timeline: apply SG change in 10m, verify conntrack drop, then create privatelink within 60m. node reprovision start after privatelink tested.
maria: postmortem notes to capture: why conntrack rose (audit sampling spikes), why SNI inspection caused extra flows, cost delta for NATGW vs privatelink, and recommend default warmup sampling to 0.1.
julia: ack. I'll create the incident doc and assign action items.
kevin: small follow-up — we should add a guard in the firewall rollouts to detect conntrack pressure (alert at 50k) and auto-rollback if join latency > 3m.
maria: agree. I'll file the alert and add to rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: action: incident-created #INC-20260321-42 — follow the incident doc for updates.
kevin: thanks everyone, keep updates to thread.
